summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for previously-blank /admin, /owner, /dashboard routes after Vercel deployment fix. All 7 requested scenarios PASS. Unauthenticated /admin, /owner, /dashboard correctly redirect to /login and render login-form (no blank screen). Unknown route /random-xyz redirects to landing '/'. After login (admin@workshop.com / workshop123) all three routes render AdminDashboard with orders-table, logout-btn, and stat cards. Status update via status-select-{id} dropdown persists and status-badge reflects the new value. Logout redirects to /login and re-accessing /admin now redirects back to /login (cookie cleared). Public landing/booking form still renders. ErrorBoundary not triggered.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext uses tri-state user (null=checking, false=anon, obj=user) - works but is fragile; a small refactor to use loading + user (obj|null) would be cleaner and eliminates the `user === null` check duplication in ProtectedRoute.

lib/api.js: BACKEND_URL fallback to '' makes baseURL relative '/api'. Good for Vercel where API is same-origin via rewrites, but if the frontend is deployed on a different origin than the backend with no proxy, requests will 404 silently. Consider logging a console.warn when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing.
ErrorBoundary present at app root - good; no runtime errors triggered during test.
seed_data_creation: Modified 1 existing booking status from Pending -> In Progress via UI during test (id 6a66034785275ff1582b93d9).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blank-screen bug on /admin, /owner, /dashboard is fixed. Route aliases and catch-all '*' -> '/' work as expected. AuthContext user tri-state + ProtectedRoute redirect chain is correct. Backend regression suite untouched at /app/backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py from iteration_1 (100% pass previously).
